name: ggref-beach
prompt: Photorealistic travel photograph of the Golden Gate Bridge in San Francisco at golden hour, taken from Marshall's Beach: the bridge's south tower and the full span rise to the right above dark wet boulders and white surf, the Marin Headlands behind, warm low sun from the left. Accurate International Orange colour, correct Art Deco tower shape with stepped portals, correct main cables and vertical suspenders. Shot on a full-frame camera, 35mm lens, natural colours, fine grain. No people, no text.

name: ggref-fort
prompt: Photorealistic photograph of the Golden Gate Bridge at sunset seen from the rocks below Fort Point: the south tower looms huge overhead and to the left, the roadway arch and steel truss visible, waves splashing on the sea wall, golden light. Accurate International Orange colour, correct Art Deco tower shape, correct cables and suspenders. 24mm lens, natural colours, fine grain. No people, no text.

name: ggref-crissy
prompt: Photorealistic photograph of the Golden Gate Bridge at golden hour seen from the sand and dune grass at Crissy Field: the whole bridge spans the frame in the distance with both towers, calm bay water, the Marin Headlands behind, low warm sun and light haze. Accurate International Orange colour and tower shape. 50mm lens, natural colours, fine grain. No people, no text.
